scope: Review-workflow toggle, mode-aware saving and signing, role permissions, transaction safety, navigation and unchanged default review behavior. Existing document fields/templates were not changed.

checks: Default review-on, public metadata safety, legacy-client compatibility, signed submissions, signature enforcement and current/archive fixtures
Anonymous, client, regular admin, CSRF, wrong method and invalid workflow updates cannot change mode
Actual superadmin off save persists across restart; optimistic conflict, stale decision and stale save are blocked without new versions, decisions or notifications
EN/AR desktop/mobile tool UI saves actual unsigned generic and both subscription PDFs with correct totals; saved account views have no active review remedies
Optional signing rejects an empty request without mutation; actual Arabic mobile upload previews/saves one optional signature while the normally required slot stays blank
Old/current links, read-only decision history, ownership, current/history ZIP exact hashes and original PDF/answers survive tool mode
Re-enable preserves decisions and locked approval, never enrolls tool-mode versions, rejects stale mode/unsigned review submissions, and keeps restored tool versions ineligible

limits: Actual mode changes and application mutations were tested only in isolated local fixtures; production workflow mode was not toggled.
Public-route and unchanged PDF checks reuse the successful pre-hotfix run; final management UI and changed asset hashes were rechecked after the hotfix.
Production preservation was verified server-side against its private backup; no client data was exported.
